purpose: Close reachability exactly for component-mediated B-C and C-X0 transitions using only P7-free List-3 calls on proper color masks; do not claim closure of dynamic-core UNKNOWN classes.

external_backend.theorem: Bonomo-Chudnovsky-Maceli-Schaudt-Stein-Zhong: List 3-Coloring is polynomial-time solvable on P7-free graphs and returns an explicit coloring.
external_backend.use: Only on induced subgraphs G[D] or G[C] with every current list contained in one palette F of size at most 3.

exact_mask_reachability.definition: rho_D(F)=1 iff G[D] has a proper coloring phi with phi(v) in A(v) cap F for all v and colors(phi(D))=F exactly.
proper_mask_compilation: If D is empty, rho_D(empty)=1 and rho_D(F)=0 for nonempty F.
For nonempty proper F with |F|<=3, enumerate one distinct witness vertex w_c in D for every c in F, force w_c=c, restrict every other list to A(v) cap F, and call P7-free List-3.
rho_D(F)=1 iff at least one witness tuple succeeds; an exact coloring certificate is retained.
exact_mask_reachability.witness_tuple_bound: At most |D|^|F| <= |D|^3 tuples per proper nonempty F.
exact_mask_reachability.full_mask_firewall: rho_D([4]) is not computed by List-4. It is only queried when a theorem proves it irrelevant.

primary_definitions.component_boundary_relation: For a component C and complete-neighbor set D, R_C(gamma)=mu_C({gamma(v):v in D}) on proper list-respecting colorings of the relevant boundary graph.

PROPER_MASK_BOUNDARY_REACHABILITY_V1.statement: For every induced P7-free boundary graph G[D] and every proper F subsetneq [4], rho_D(F) is decidable constructively in polynomial time using only P7-free List-3 calls, with an explicit exact-mask coloring witness when reachable.
PROPER_MASK_BOUNDARY_REACHABILITY_V1.complexity: O(sum_{proper F} |D|^|F| * T_L3(|D|)) = O(|D|^3*T_L3(|D|)) up to a constant 15-mask factor.

B_C_REACHABILITY_AWARE_NEUTRALITY_IFF_V1.setup: For component C and dynamic b, let D^- be the common baseline complete-neighbor set excluding b. Compare state0 D0=D^- and state1 D1=D^- union {b}, with fixed mu_C and all other boundary/list data frozen.
B_C_REACHABILITY_AWARE_NEUTRALITY_IFF_V1.source_consistency_guard: If D^- is empty, state0 would leave residual C uncoupled, contradicting sealed C2 in the final source state. Therefore this pair is not a two-sided source-consistent B-C transition and no mu_C(empty) / List-4 query is permitted.
B_C_REACHABILITY_AWARE_NEUTRALITY_IFF_V1.exact_delta: Delta_BC(C,b)={(F,alpha): rho_{D^-}(F)=1, alpha in A(b), mu_C(F)!=mu_C(F union {alpha})}.
B_C_REACHABILITY_AWARE_NEUTRALITY_IFF_V1.monotonicity_fact: Any distinguishing pair has alpha notin F and necessarily mu_C(F)=1, mu_C(F union {alpha})=0.
B_C_REACHABILITY_AWARE_NEUTRALITY_IFF_V1.local_legality: For a distinguishing pair alpha notin F, any exact-F coloring of D^- together with b=alpha is proper on G[D^- union {b}] regardless of b-D^- edges, because no vertex of D^- uses alpha.
B_C_REACHABILITY_AWARE_NEUTRALITY_IFF_V1.iff: Delta_BC is empty iff the two states induce the same local component-boundary feasibility relation on every proper list-respecting coloring of D^- union {b}.
B_C_REACHABILITY_AWARE_NEUTRALITY_IFF_V1.nonneutral_certificate: When Delta_BC is nonempty, retain F, alpha, an exact-F coloring witness of D^-, the C0 witness for the mu=1 side, and the sealed mu=0 table entry for the other side.
B_C_REACHABILITY_AWARE_NEUTRALITY_IFF_V1.ceiling: PROVED_NONNEUTRAL is for the local component-boundary relation, not automatically for existence of a coloring of the entire dynamic U-core.

C_X0_RECOMPILED_MESSAGE_REACHABILITY_IFF.setup: Compare two component base-list systems Bsys_C^0,Bsys_C^1 differing only by one selected C-X0 identity incidence; D_C is unchanged and nonempty.
C_X0_RECOMPILED_MESSAGE_REACHABILITY_IFF.compilation: Run the sealed C0 compiler separately on both base systems for all nonempty masks. This uses at most 15 P7-free List-3 calls per state.
C_X0_RECOMPILED_MESSAGE_REACHABILITY_IFF.full_mask_fact: For nonempty C, mu_C^0([4])=mu_C^1([4])=0 because every list B_C(u)\[4] is empty. Hence [4] can never distinguish the two messages.
C_X0_RECOMPILED_MESSAGE_REACHABILITY_IFF.exact_delta: Delta_CX0={F proper subset [4]: rho_{D_C}(F)=1 and mu_C^0(F)!=mu_C^1(F)}.
C_X0_RECOMPILED_MESSAGE_REACHABILITY_IFF.iff: Delta_CX0 is empty iff the two base-system states induce the same local component-boundary feasibility relation on all reachable boundary masks.
C_X0_RECOMPILED_MESSAGE_REACHABILITY_IFF.nonneutral_certificate: Retain reachable F with exact boundary coloring witness, plus C0 pass witness for the good state and bad table entry for the other.

COMPONENT_TRANSITION_SIGNATURE_V1.B_C_signature: rho proper-mask bits (15 canonical positions; empty bit is zero under two-sided source-consistency), message_type_id, A(b), and a 64-slot delta bitset indexed by (F,alpha), with irrelevant/full-mask slots fixed zero.
COMPONENT_TRANSITION_SIGNATURE_V1.C_X0_signature: rho proper-mask bits, message_type_id before/after, and a 15-slot reachable-message-difference bitset.
COMPONENT_TRANSITION_SIGNATURE_V1.adequacy: For the local component-boundary feasibility query, equal signatures imply equal classified transition behavior. Reconstruction after solving retains a pointer to the actual source state and uses that state's C0 witness table; witnesses need not be identical across neutral states.

lifecycle.per_boundary_mask: At most |D|^3 List-3 calls in the worst |F|=3 case.
lifecycle.per_BC_pair: Constantly many proper masks, hence polynomial.
lifecycle.all_BC_pairs: At most O(n^2) component/dynamic candidate pairs, giving a crude polynomial O(n^5*T_L3(n)) bound before caching/shared computations.
lifecycle.C_X0: Recompile each affected component state with <=15 List-3 calls plus one rho signature; even O(n^2) candidate identity transitions remain polynomial.
lifecycle.cache_allowed: rho_D and message compilations may be memoized, but polynomiality does not rely on memoization.

explicit_nonclaims: No claim that all B2 UNKNOWN classes are resolved.
B-X0 with a genuinely new forbidden color remains dynamic-core reachability OPEN.
B-B with overlapping exact palettes remains dynamic-core reachability OPEN.
Unsupported S-* and other pair classes remain OPEN/UNKNOWN.
Local boundary PROVED_NONNEUTRAL does not imply a globally source-valid whole-U distinguishing coloring.
No global kappa transition quotient is sealed by this gate.

terminals.PASS_PROPER_MASK_BOUNDARY_REACHABILITY: rho_D(F) is polynomially constructible for every proper mask F with exact witnesses.
terminals.PASS_BC_REACHABILITY_AWARE_IFF: Every two-sided source-consistent B-C transition is exactly classified NEUTRAL/NONNEUTRAL at local component-boundary level.
terminals.PASS_CX0_RECOMPILED_MESSAGE_IFF: Every C-X0 component-base transition in scope is exactly classified at local component-boundary level.
terminals.PASS_COMPONENT_TRANSITION_SIGNATURE: Constant-size exact-interface signatures are proved adequate for the declared local component-transition query/reconstruction contract.
terminals.OPEN_DYNAMIC_CORE_REACHABILITY: Non-component-mediated B2 UNKNOWN classes remain unresolved.

falsifiers: A distinguishing B-C pair requires F=[4].
Exact proper-mask reachability cannot be reduced to polynomially many common-palette List-3 instances.
A two-sided source-consistent B-C transition exists with D^-=empty.
C-X0 messages differ only at F=[4].
Equal proposed signatures can induce different local component-boundary feasibility or reconstruction obligations.
